title: Card
description: The bento content card: panel fill and the style's card border, radius and resting shadow. interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item.
when: Group the content of a page in cards; nested facts in TILE.
a11y: A clickable card is a link or button inside the card, not a div with onClick.
notes: Pass padding and layout only: no bg-* or shadow-* on <Card> (card-class-override).
